regions.today: Warm and sunny. Some high cloud developing later in the day turning the sunshine hazy. Highest temperatures of 19 to 24 degrees, warmest further inland, in a mostly light easterly breeze.
regions.tonight: Dry with clear spells. Lowest temperatures of 11 to 15 degrees with light and variable winds.
regions.tomorrow: Humid with a mix of cloud and long spells of sunshine. While it will continue dry in most places, a few sharp showers are possible in the southeast and east. Highest temperatures of 22 to 27 degrees in just light easterly breezes.
regions.pollen: Very high on Sunday and Monday.
